<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" pages="2" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="zqSMDlWrzXvEqAeAiPA9" name="Trang-3"> <mxGraphModel grid="1" page="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam nodeStyle rectangle
skinparam roundCorner 6
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam defaultFontName Arial
skinparam defaultFontSize 12
skinparam linetype ortho

skinparam node {
 BackgroundColor #F8F9FA
 BorderColor #333333
 BorderThickness 1.5
}

skinparam component {
 BackgroundColor #F0F7FF
 BorderColor #0066CC
 BorderThickness 1.2
}

skinparam artifact {
 BackgroundColor #FFF8F0
 BorderColor #D97706
 BorderThickness 1.2
}

skinparam database {
 BackgroundColor #F0FDF4
 BorderColor #16A34A
 BorderThickness 1.5
}

skinparam cloud {
 BackgroundColor #FAF5FF
 BorderColor #9333EA
 BorderThickness 1.5
}

skinparam note {
 BackgroundColor #FEFCE8
 BorderColor #CA8A04
}

' ========================================================
' 1. CLIENT DEVICE (ĐẦY ĐỦ CHI TIẾT THEO CHUẨN UML & ĐỒ ÁN)
' ========================================================
node \"<<Device>> Client Device\n(Smartphone / Tablet / PC)\" as ClientDevice {

 node \"<<executionEnvironment>> Web Browser / PWA Shell\n(Chrome, Safari, Android WebAPK, iOS PWA)\" as BrowserEnv {
 
 artifact \"<<artifact>> Customer Interface\n(Next.js Mobile-First UI)\n[Port: Outbound HTTPS 443 | Local Dev: 3000]\" as CustUI
 
 component \"Client LocalStorage\n• Cart Store (Zustand)\n• JWT Auth Token\" as LocalStorageComp
 component \"PWA Service Worker\n& manifest.json\" as ServiceWorker
 
 CustUI ..> LocalStorageComp : read / write
 CustUI ..> ServiceWorker : register & cache
 }
}

' ========================================================
' 2. PRODUCTION SERVER / DOCKER HOST (THEO ĐÚNG KHUÔN HÌNH 1)
' ========================================================
node \"Production Server / Docker Host\" as DockerHost {

 node \"Backend Container: NestJS API (Port 3001)\" as BackendContainer {
 
 artifact \"<<artifact>>\nbrewlite_api\" as RootApp
 
 ' Các Artifact dịch vụ theo kiến trúc Hình 2
 artifact \"<<artifact>>\nGuestService\" as GuestArt
 artifact \"<<artifact>>\nMemberService\" as MemberArt
 artifact \"<<artifact>>\nOrderPaymentService\" as OrderArt
 
 RootApp *-- GuestArt
 RootApp *-- MemberArt
 RootApp *-- OrderArt
 
 ' Các Component thực thi chi tiết toàn bộ nghiệp vụ Backend
 component \"ProductsService\n• GET /products & /products/:id\n• Size, Topping & SugarIceCalc\" as ProdComp
 component \"AuthService\n• POST /auth/login, /register\n• JWT Guard & Validation\" as AuthComp
 component \"PromotionsService\n• DiscountStrategy (Fixed / %)\n• Loyalty Points Calculation\" as PromoComp
 component \"OrdersService\n• OrderStateMachine\n• Recipe & Inventory Management\" as OrdersComp
 component \"PaymentsService\n• IdempotencyKey Check\n• Wallet & Card PaymentStrategy\" as PayComp
 component \"PrismaService (ORM)\n• PostgreSQL Client\n• $transaction ACID Management\" as PrismaComp

 ' Quan hệ Manifest từ Artifact sang Component
 GuestArt ..> ProdComp : <<manifest>>
 MemberArt ..> AuthComp : <<manifest>>
 MemberArt ..> PromoComp : <<manifest>>
 OrderArt ..> OrdersComp : <<manifest>>
 OrderArt ..> PayComp : <<manifest>>
 OrderArt ..> PrismaComp : <<manifest>>
 }

 note right of BackendContainer
 **Backend Configuration:**
 - Environment Secrets (.env)
 - Health Check (/health)
 - Application Logging (NestJS)
 - Security (CORS & Helmet)
 end note
}

' ========================================================
' 3. DATABASE SERVER (THEO ĐÚNG KHUÔN HÌNH 1)
' ========================================================
node \"Database Server / Secure Network\" as DBServer {
 database \"PostgreSQL (Port 5432)\" as DB {
 [Docker Volume Storage] as DBStorage
 }
}

' ========================================================
' 4. EXTERNAL SERVICES (THEO ĐÚNG KHUÔN HÌNH 1)
' ========================================================
cloud \"External Services\" as ExtCloud {
 [Mock Payment Gateway\n(ZaloPay Sandbox / VNPay Sandbox)] as MockPayment
}

' ========================================================
' CÁC ĐƯỜNG KẾT NỐI CHÍNH (CHUẨN KHUÔN HÌNH 1)
' ========================================================
CustUI --> RootApp : HTTPS / REST API (Port 443 ➔ Port 3001)

PrismaComp --> DB : TCP / SQL (Port 5432 - Internal Network)
PayComp --> MockPayment : HTTP POST /payments (HMAC Signature)

@enduml",
 "config": null
